description: List what Besidka remembers about you: account memory, or the memory of one project when projectId is given, or both with the all scope. Each entry has an id, category, title, description, body and the project it belongs to (null for account memory). Requires signing in (memory:read).

projectId.description: List the memory of this project instead of your account. Use with the project scope or without a scope

scope.description: account (default), project (needs projectId) or all, which lists your account memory and the memory of every project

name: list_memory
title: List my memory
